div.head: Whiston’s chapter headings (compiled index)
div.note: These headings are transcribed from the 1856 Auburn and Rochester printing of William Whiston’s translation. Their arrangement as an index is editorial; this is not a reproduction of an original printed table of contents.
div.head: BOOK VIII.
div.p: CONTAINING THE INTERVAL OF ONE HUNDRED AND SIXTY-THREE YEARS.
FROM THE DEATH OF DAVID TO THE DEATH OF AHAB.

list.label: I
list.item: HOW SOLOMON, WHEN HE HAD RECEIVED THE KINGDOM, TOOK OFF HIS ENEMIES.
list.label: II
list.item: CONCERNING THE WIFE OF SOLOMON; CONCERNING HIS WISDOM AND RICHES; AND CONCERNING WHAT HE OBTAINED OF HIRAM FOR THE BUILDING OF THE TEMPLE.
list.label: III
list.item: OF THE BUILDING OF THE TEMPLE.
list.label: IV
list.item: HOW SOLOMON REMOVED THE ARK INTO THE TEMPLE; HOW HE MADE SUPPLICATION TO GOD, AND OFFERED PUBLIC SACRIFICES TO HIM.
list.label: V
list.item: HOW SOLOMON BUILT HIMSELF A ROYAL PALACE, VERY COSTLY AND SPLENDID; AND HOW HE SOLVED THE RIDDLES WHICH WERE SENT HIM BY HIRAM.
list.label: VI
list.item: HOW SOLOMON FORTIFIED THE CITY OF JERUSALEM, AND BUILT GREAT CITIES; AND HOW HE BROUGHT SOME OF THE CANAANITES INTO SUBJECTION, AND ENTERTAINED THE QUEEN OF EGYPT AND OF ETHIOPIA.
list.label: VII
list.item: HOW SOLOMON GREW RICH, AND FELL DESPERATELY IN LOVE WITH WOMEN, AND HOW GOD, BEING INCENSED AT IT, RAISED UP ADER AND JEROBOAM AGAINST HIM. CONCERNING THE DEATH OF SOLOMON.
list.label: VIII
list.item: HOW, UPON THE DEATH OF SOLOMON, THE PEOPLE FORSOOK HIS SON REHOBOAM, AND ORDAINED JEROBOAM KING OVER THE TEN TRIBES.
list.label: IX
list.item: HOW JADON THE PROPHET WAS PERSUADED BY ANOTHER LYING PROPHET, AND RETURNED [TO BETHEL], AND WAS AFTERWARDS SLAIN BY A LION. AS ALSO WHAT WORDS THE WICKED PROPHET MADE USE OF TO PERSUADE THE KING, AND THEREBY ALIENATED HIS MIND FROM GOD.
list.label: X
list.item: CONCERNING REHOBOAM, AND HOW GOD INFLICTED PUNISHMENT UPON HIM FOR HIS IMPIETY, BY SHISHAK [KING OF EGYPT].
list.label: XI
list.item: CONCERNING THE DEATH OF A SON OF JEROBOAM. HOW JEROBOAM WAS BEATEN BY ABIJAH, WHO DIED A LITTLE AFTERWARDS, AND WAS SUCCEEDED IN HIS KINGDOM BY ASA. AND ALSO HOW, AFTER THE DEATH OF JEROBOAM, BAASHA DESTROYED HIS SON NADAB, AND ALL THE HOUSE OF JEROBOAM.
list.label: XII
list.item: HOW ZERAH, KING OF THE ETHIOPIANS, WAS BEATEN BY ASA; AND HOW ASA, UPON BAASHA'S MAKING WAR AGAINST HIM, INVITED THE KING OF THE DAMASCENS TO ASSIST HIM; AND HOW, ON THE DESTRUCTION OF THE HOUSE OF BAASHA, ZIMRI GOT THE KINGDOM, AS DID HIS SON AHAB AFTER HIM.
list.label: XIII
list.item: HOW AHAB, WHEN HE HAD TAKEN JEZEBEL TO WIFE, BECAME MORE WICKED THAN ALL THE KINGS THAT HAD BEEN BEFORE HIM. OF THE ACTIONS OF THE PROPHET ELIJAH; AND WHAT BEFEL NABOTH.
list.label: XIV
list.item: HOW HADAD, KING OF DAMASCUS AND OF SYRIA, MADE TWO EXPEDITIONS AGAINST AHAB, AND WAS BEATEN.
list.label: XV
list.item: CONCERNING JEHOSHAPHAT, THE KING OF JERUSALEM; AND HOW AHAB MADE AN EXPEDITION AGAINST THE SYRIANS, AND WAS ASSISTED THEREIN BY JEHOSHAPHAT, BUT WAS HIMSELF OVERCOME IN BATTLE, AND PERISHED THEREIN.
